request.input: Permission for a 10 year planning permission for a wind farm development comprising 7 no. wind turbines with a maximum tip height of 150m, an electricity substation, underground cabling and all associated site works.

subcategory.instructions: This is an Irish planning application description. Descriptions rarely say 'wind farm' or 'solar farm': a wind farm appears as 'N turbines', permission for X years for N turbines, tip height changes; a solar farm appears as ground-mounted solar PV panels or arrays, hectares of panels. Which subcategory best describes the main purpose of this development?

criteria.hybrid: Two or more of wind / solar / battery storage in the same application, 1 MW or more in total.
criteria.wind: Wind turbines or wind farm of 1 MW or more: installation of N turbines, permission or extension of permission for N turbines, turbine replacement (repowering), extensions.
criteria.solar: Ground-mounted solar PV installation (solar farm) of 1 MW or more.
criteria.bess: Battery energy storage system as the main development, any size.
criteria.substation: Electricity substation (new or upgraded) serving the grid or generation.
criteria.energy_support: Construction works giving relevant support to energy projects: national roads, electricity cables to substations, substation extensions to serve wind or solar farms. Must be a construction work.
criteria.leu: Large energy user: factory, industrial complex, or housing development of 200 or more homes in one application.
criteria.low_energy: Wind/solar/hybrid under 1 MW; fewer than 200 homes; generation from other sources (biomass, diesel, gas, CHP) of any size; small substations in houses, schools or supermarkets; rooftop solar panels; EV charging points.
criteria.not_energy: Everything else, including fences, car parks, buildings that are not substations, depots and warehouses, even when part of a wind farm, solar farm or large energy user.

category.instructions: This is an Irish planning application description. Descriptions rarely say 'wind farm' or 'solar farm': a wind farm appears as 'N turbines', permission for X years for N turbines, tip height changes; a solar farm appears as ground-mounted solar PV panels or arrays, hectares of panels. Is this an energy development?

criteria.energy: The development is an energy development (generation, storage, grid, energy support works, large energy user or data centre).
criteria.not_energy: The development is not an energy development, or is only low energy.
